answer: Discount lockstep votes: each epoch the network measures how often every pair of graders agrees beyond chance. Pairs that rise and fall like one tide across every ballot have their attestation weight divided by their overlap, so a juniper thicket of fake accounts echoing one operator counts as one voice. To reach the zenith of influence, an attacker must make each sybil disagree for real, which spoils the consensus they wanted to buy and burns their stake on wrong grades.
